pages.name: Cover

objects.text: A short introduction to what we are building, who it is for and why the time is now.
objects.name: Subtitle

pages.notes: Welcome everyone and say who you are in one sentence. Give the one-line promise of the company, then the three things you will cover: the problem, the shift that makes it solvable now, and what you need from the room.

pages.name: Three reasons

objects.text: Three shifts make this the moment
objects.name: Title

objects.text: Work is scattered across too many tools
objects.name: Heading 1

objects.text: Teams lose hours every week moving between apps just to find the latest version of anything.
objects.name: Body 1

objects.text: People expect software to feel simple
objects.name: Heading 2

objects.text: Customers now compare every product with the easiest one they use, and they leave when it is not.
objects.name: Body 2

objects.text: Getting started takes minutes, not months
objects.name: Heading 3

objects.text: What once took a consultant and a quarter can now be running before the first meeting ends.
objects.name: Body 3

objects.text: Sample figures: replace them with your own and name the source.
objects.name: Source

pages.notes: One reason per column. Spend about a minute on each: read the number, say what it means for a real customer, then move on. Replace the figures with your own and cite the source in the notes.

pages.name: Closing

objects.text: Let us build what comes next, together.
objects.name: Subtitle

pages.notes: Finish with the ask in one sentence, then stop talking. Leave this slide up during questions so people can write down how to reach you.
